purpose: Non-secret default source-confidence registry for cited manual/internet evidence. Workers must profile every citation with these fields and rate newly discovered sources by analogy before using them.
source_diversity_rule: Low or very_low confidence sources may not be sole support for any score-bearing claim. Prefer at least two independent source types for material claims where available, and explain gaps in closed or low-information environments.

unlisted_source_policy.allowed_use: Rate by publisher, authorship, evidence proximity, incentives, and claim type before use; upgrade or downgrade in source_confidence_reason.
unlisted_source_policy.caveats: Do not use an unprofiled source as sole final evidence. Record why the discovered source is reliable enough for the claim type. Add durable high-value sources to this registry after the run.

source_profiles.allowed_use: Structured local priors and locally ingested datasets are strong final evidence for the fields they directly measure.
source_profiles.caveats: Do not treat absence of a local fact as absence of real-world evidence; pair with narrative sources for ruler-specific actions.

source_profiles.allowed_use: Final evidence for election administration, media environment, legal framework, and observer findings.
source_profiles.caveats: Note mission scope, whether observation was limited, and whether findings cover the target year.

source_profiles.allowed_use: Final evidence for observed elections, legal frameworks, campaign conditions, and institutional recommendations.
source_profiles.caveats: Use only for directly observed cases or clearly identified EU mission reports.

source_profiles.allowed_use: Final evidence for election observation in OAS-covered countries.
source_profiles.caveats: Check mission mandate, date, and whether the report addresses entrenchment-relevant institutions.

source_profiles.allowed_use: Final evidence for election observation and democratic-process assessments where the Center had mission coverage.
source_profiles.caveats: Distinguish direct observation findings from secondary background narrative.

source_profiles.allowed_use: Final evidence for electoral-system, constitutional, and democracy-assistance records when directly documented.
source_profiles.caveats: Use country pages and reports as institutional context; corroborate specific misconduct allegations.

source_profiles.allowed_use: Final evidence for documented rights abuses, intimidation, media pressure, and security-force conduct when claims are sourced and dated.
source_profiles.caveats: Prefer detailed reports over press summaries; corroborate highly contested or single-source allegations.

source_profiles.allowed_use: Final evidence for documented repression, prosecutions, detention, and abuse connected to political contestation.
source_profiles.caveats: Check whether the evidence is target-year, near-period, or broader ruler-period context.

source_profiles.allowed_use: Final evidence for formal facts such as laws, official results, dates, judgments, procedural rules, and officeholder records.
source_profiles.caveats: Use with care for self-assessments, claims of fairness, disputed results, or allegations against the incumbent; corroborate those claims independently.

claim_type_overrides.reason: Primary source for official text, dates, procedural rules, certified results, or judgments.
Official actors have incentives to frame incumbent conduct or institutional independence favorably.

source_profiles.domain: *.gov, *.gov.*, ministries, presidency, prime minister, ruling-party-controlled state outlets
source_profiles.allowed_use: Use with care. Suitable for formal facts and official positions; not sufficient alone for self-serving claims about fairness, legality, restraint, or absence of manipulation.
source_profiles.caveats: For self-serving claims, require independent corroboration from observers, courts, NGOs, intergovernmental bodies, or reputable media.

claim_type_overrides.reason: Official site can be a primary source for text, date, office, law, decree, budget, or procedural publication.
Self-interested source for claims about its own democratic restraint or legitimacy.

source_profiles.source: Reuters / Associated Press / BBC / major reputable international wire or public-service media
source_profiles.domain: reuters.com, apnews.com, bbc.com, and comparable outlets
source_profiles.allowed_use: Final evidence for chronology, attributed statements, event reporting, and corroborating details, especially when primary reports are unavailable.
source_profiles.caveats: Prefer original observer/legal/NGO sources for analytic conclusions; preserve attribution and uncertainty.

source_profiles.allowed_use: Orientation, basic facts, names, dates, office chronology, and discovery of primary sources through references.
source_profiles.caveats: Mostly orientation/basic facts. Do not use as sole support for score-bearing manipulation claims; follow citations to primary or higher-confidence sources when possible.

source_profiles.allowed_use: Discovery only, if encountered. Use only to find leads that are verified elsewhere.
source_profiles.caveats: Very low confidence; never sole support and normally excluded from final evidence.
